notes:
BUILD 22
- Two harder places on the map: the ARMS DEPOT (a walled yard behind a blast gate, six turrets, ten heavies, and two blockhouses each behind a blast door of its own with locked crates inside) and a LARGE OIL RIG (far more heavies and turrets, extra locked crates up on the helipad).
- Patrol helicopters no longer just vanish: shot down, they spin, smoke, fall and blow up where they land.
- Space while swimming kicks you up out of the water, enough to get onto a jetty or a bank.
- Gunships and gunboats leave open crates of guns and gear where they go down (afloat if at sea): 2 from a patrol helicopter, 1 from a boat.
- New event: every 40 to 60 minutes a big ATTACK HELICOPTER roams the island (marked ! on the compass). It leaves you alone until you hit it. Then it comes for you with guns and rockets. Five times a patrol helicopter's health; drops four crates with the best loot in the game.
- The weapon shop sells satchel charges (120 scrap each) instead of rockets.
- The lamp on a locked crate turns green when the lock is beaten.
- Turrets are easier to hit (bigger hit box), and boats and gunships no longer shoot through walls and decks.
